what.text: Refugees from Western Sahara reside in host countries including Algeria, France, Cuba, Angola, and Venezuela.
By the end of 2025, Algeria hosted 173600 refugees from Western Sahara.
Algeria accounted for 99.4% of all refugees from Western Sahara in 2025.

why.text: The sources don't say what specific conflicts or events caused people to flee Western Sahara.
No specific opposition groups or active conflict periods are listed in the provided data.

when.text: Refugee counts in Algeria stood at 20000 at the end of 1975.
The population reached a peak of 173600 in 2024 and remained at that level in 2025.
The data notes major shifts between 1975 and 1976, between 1980 and 1981, and between 2023 and 2024.

how.text: The sources don't say what routes people traveled or how refugees live in host locations.
Instead, the data reports year-end totals of refugees from Western Sahara in Algeria counted under UNHCR mandate.
